{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check severity categories
print("Severity categories:", data['severity'].unique())

# Check if 'SEVERE' exists
has_severe = 'severe' in data['severity'].unique()
print("Has 'severe' category:", has_severe)

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check if biomarker_baseline is in ng/mL
# According to documentation, biomarker_baseline is always in ng/mL, regardless of assay batch
# So no unit conversion needed for baseline

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Number of duplicate patient_id values:", data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check sample_seq: highest sample_seq should be kept
print("Max sample_seq per patient:", data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().describe())"}
